text.what: An hour south of Melbourne with sea on three sides. Maritime, cool, and cut into small holdings — vineyards here are measured in a few hectares, not a few hundred.

kin.as: Grown cool and picked early, beside chardonnay.
Victoria's other pinot region, inland and in the hills.
